documentation.accessibilityText:
CANONICAL REQUIREMENTS

Accessibility contract
Run component QA →
NATIVE SEMANTICS

Use dialog or tooltip semantics appropriate to the primitive and never apply one generic overlay role.

KEYBOARD

Tab, Shift+Tab, Escape, Enter, Space

FOCUS

Initial Focus, Containment When Modal, Restore Focus, Nested Scope Arbitration

WCAG REFERENCES

1.3.1, 1.4.13, 2.1.1, 2.1.2, 2.4.3, 2.4.7, 2.4.11, 4.1.2

These requirements come from the canonical Dialog catalog entry. Application copy, labels, custom styling, and composed workflows still require product-level testing.
documentation.usageCode:
import {
  DialogRoot,
  DialogTrigger,
  DialogPortal,
  DialogBackdrop,
  DialogPositioner,
  DialogContent,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogClose,
} from '@uifn/components-react/dialog'
import '@uifn/components/styles.css'

export function Example() {
  return (
    <DialogRoot>
      <DialogTrigger type="button">Open example</DialogTrigger>
      <DialogPortal>
        <DialogBackdrop />
        <DialogPositioner>
          <DialogContent>
            Component content
            <DialogTitle>Example title</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>A production composition rendered from the public styled package.</DialogDescription>
            <DialogClose type="button">Close</DialogClose>
          </DialogContent>
        </DialogPositioner>
      </DialogPortal>
    </DialogRoot>
  )
}
